content.text:
type Tenant {
  _cruds: [String!]!
  activeEnd: DateTime
  activeStart: DateTime
  address: Address
  areaTypeTemplates: [AreaTypeTemplate!]
  cobraEndpoint: String
  cobraSecret: Secret
  cobraSecretId: String
  features: FeatureSet
  hasRemoteContacts: Boolean!
  headerImage: String
  itemTypeTemplates: [ItemTypeTemplate!]
  komGisPermissionsEndpoint: String
  komGisPermissionsSecret: Secret
---MEMBER---
type Member {
  _cruds: [String!]!
  id: ID
  preferences: MemberPreference
  role: Role!
  teams: [MemberOnTeam!]
  tenant: Tenant
  user: User
}
---PORTFOLIO---
type Portfolio {
  _cruds: [String!]!
  assetPermissions: Asset
  assets: [Asset!]
  assetsCount: Int!
  bounds: [Float!]
  color: String
  contactRecipientFallback: Contact
  contactRecipientFallbackId: String
  contactRecipientPrivacyUrl: String
  contactRecipientProperty: Property
  contactRecipientPropertyId: String

observation.command: cd /workspace && awk '/^type Tenant \{/,/^\}/' api/lib/graphql/schema.graphql | head -15; echo "---MEMBER---"; awk '/^type Member \{/,/^\}/' api/lib/graphql/schema.graphql | head -15; echo "---PORTFOLIO---"; awk '/^type Portfolio \{/,/^\}/' api/lib/graphql/schema.graphql | head -12
